Statistical methods and populations
Reference distributions retain their source population when filtering. Intervals are supplied values; filtering does not recalculate them.

Source observations


Made with Natural Earth · public-domain country boundaries at 1:110m. Population estimates are from the pinned source snapshot (mostly 2019; see each row’s year), not current estimates. Antarctica is excluded. Country/map units and boundaries follow the source. Python measured the axes and outlined text. This prototype renders circles, line segments, bars and polygon regions with fixed page geometry, clips them to their plot areas and preserves row identity. Page zoom moves the whole drawing; it does not recalculate domains or ticks. Data and runtime are embedded for offline use.
